faqEntries.response: Yes. We have case studies for seven projects: Uplift.ai, Fast VPN, Emyy, USR CRM, OriusPay, TruNext and XENPOP. Each covers the project overview, challenge, solution, features and technologies.

Uplift.ai is a mobile fitness app that combines training, meals and daily health tracking with an AI coach. Adelogix designed, developed and deployed it in 2023 over about 3–4 months. It includes 11 user flows and a design system with colour, type and effect styles.

Fast VPN is an iOS app that connects users to a secure server in a single tap. Adelogix designed, developed and delivered it in 2025 over about 2–2.5 months. It includes 193 screens in light and dark mode, a built-in speed test, and Face ID/Touch ID/PIN security.
followUp: How many screens does Fast VPN have?

faqEntries.response: Emyy is a local services marketplace connecting customers with local freelancers. Adelogix developed the mobile app and website, delivered in February 2026. It has 57 mobile screens, 6 web pages and 2 user roles (customer and freelancer), with Stripe payments and real-time booking states.
followUp: How many screens does Emyy have?
What are the two user roles?

faqEntries.response: USR CRM is a web CRM for a UK team of international DJs and music producers. Adelogix redesigned and developed it in 2026 with a calm stone and sage interface, 14 desktop screens each with a matching mobile layout, live quotes, event sheets, a DJ colour-coded calendar and admin reports.
followUp: How many screens does USR CRM have?

faqEntries.response: OriusPay is a merchant finance dashboard designed and developed end to end by Adelogix in 2026. It has 17 modules on one sidebar — KPI cards, cash flow, transaction pipeline, Horus AI assistant, Quick Actions for payment links and QR codes, VAT compliance, and MFA security.
followUp: How many modules does OriusPay have?

faqEntries.response: TruNext is a crypto investment platform built around GNSE, its gold-backed token. Adelogix designed the full UI/UX across three surfaces — web app, mobile app and admin panel — in 2026. It features four investment packages, USDT and gold-backed token wallets, Skrill cashout, and a referral program.
followUp: How many surfaces does TruNext have?

faqEntries.response: XENPOP is a community-powered crypto mining platform. People mine and earn coins from their phone with no special hardware.
